about.heroLead: A blog for people learning to build sites and services — from markup to production — without wading through academic dryness.
about.storyP1: Hi! I started it_hlp to collect, in one place, write-ups on the things I've had to figure out myself as a developer — from JavaScript and React basics to Docker, databases, and what actually happens when a site "ships" to a server. No fluff, and no pretending it's all trivial — just plain, step-by-step explanations.
about.storyP2: I'm building the site itself too — FastAPI backend, React frontend — and it keeps growing new features: search, comments, favorites, a profile with an avatar. It's somewhere between a blog and a learning pet project, and that feels right — if I'm writing about development, the site itself might as well be a living example of it.
about.wipNote: This page is still a work in progress — I'll keep expanding and polishing it, same as the rest of the site.
